entries.reason: Fixes a genuine unstructured-Task ordering race in 'binary request errors release the serializer for following requests' (the only recurring SPM Package Tests flake in this repo's CI history). Test-only: the second request now starts only after the first visibly claims the serializer, with exact-frame assertions added. No production Swift source changed.

Replaces two fixed 40 ms sleeps with waits on the service's own recorded state in 'pathUpdate cancel after save does not cascade-delete messages' and 'setDeltaSyncHandler nil then reinstall still syncs pending keys'; each failed once in this repo's CI when a slow runner had not processed the injected event in 40 ms. Test-only; no production Swift source changed and no assertion was weakened.
